create_dataframe_tracer: create a DataFrameTracer that traces a PyTorch DataPipe as a DataFrame with schema inference
build_capture_dataframe: build a CaptureDataFrame to record DataFrame operations for later execution
test_capture_operations: test capturing arithmetic, attribute access, and indexing operations on a DataFrame
run_dataframe_batch: run batch, groupby, and shuffle operations on a traced DataFrame DataPipe
disable_capture_mode: disable capture mode globally using disable_capture to stop recording operations
